intro: MailStorm (referred to as “we”, “us”, or “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our application.
oauth: We receive your name, email address, and Google OAuth access and refresh tokens to send messages you request. Google credentials are encrypted on the server. Your browser receives a separate application session token.
uploads: Recipient data, message templates, and delivery records are stored to support background sending, progress recovery, and duplicate prevention. Database message data is encrypted. Production uploads are stored in private encrypted object storage; local development uses private files.
sharing: We do not sell or rent your personal information or Google account data. Recipient addresses and message content are sent to Google to deliver your emails.
retention: Application sessions last up to seven days and are stored in browser sessionStorage. Sign out removes the browser session and requests server session revocation. Campaigns continue when a tab closes; Cancel requests that remaining sends stop. Completed, cancelled, invalid, or paused campaigns and their records are retained for 30 days after their last activity by default. Active campaigns remain until they finish or are cancelled. A running worker removes expired records and unreferenced uploads; unused uploads become eligible for deletion after one hour. Idle Google credentials are removed after 30 days when no campaigns or live sessions reference them. Deployment retention settings may vary; backups follow the hosting operator's retention policy. Downloaded logs remain wherever you save them.
security: OAuth client secrets and Google tokens remain on the backend. Application session tokens are accessible to scripts on the application origin; use HTTPS in production. Encryption keys and storage credentials must be protected by the hosting operator. Google authorization can be revoked from your Google account settings.
